_meta.name: SpendSync Design System
_meta.purpose: Reusable UI/UX design token system. Every value is taken verbatim from the working implementation. Use this file as the single source of truth when building any new prototype in this design language.

colors._note: Register all tokens in tailwind.config inside theme.extend.colors. Use token names in classes e.g. bg-primary, text-on-surface.

typography._note: headline = Manrope (ALWAYS). body = Inter (ALWAYS). label = Inter uppercase. These map to Tailwind fontFamily tokens.

scale.ai_label: text-[11px] font-bold font-headline tracking-wider text-primary uppercase

border_radius._note: In this Tailwind config, rounded-full = 0.75rem (NOT a circle). This is the core brand shape.
border_radius.full: rounded-full — 0.75rem — ALL cards, pills, inputs, buttons, toasts, nav items
border_radius.xl: rounded-xl — 0.5rem — analytics chart containers, top-subscriptions list items, KPI cards, SMS data grid
border_radius.2xl: rounded-2xl — ONLY for SMS classify option buttons and parsed data card inside bottom sheet
border_radius.t-3xl: rounded-t-3xl — ONLY for bottom sheet top corners and bottom nav top corners
border_radius.lg: rounded-lg — ONLY for icon boxes in top subscriptions list (analytics screen)
border_radius.rule: When in doubt: rounded-full. Only use smaller radii for components explicitly listed above.

editorial.usage: Toasts, bottom sheet, floating action bar, alert rows, AI nudge pill

card_stack.usage: Stacked bank cards, card preview in Add Card

toast.entry_code: el.style.transform='translateY(-120%)'; el.classList.remove('hidden'); requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ el.style.transition='transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)'; el.style.transform='translateY(0)'; });

bottom_sheet.exit_code: sh.style.transform='translateY(100%)'; setTimeout(()=>{ hide overlay; hide sheet; show nav; }, 400);

navigation_system.pattern: Single HTML page — all screens are divs. Only active screen is visible.
navigate_steps: call render function for target screen

sms_flow_steps: 1. simulateSMS() — reads smsQueue[0], sets pendingSMS, resets step/type/cycle
2. showSMSToast(sms) — injects HTML, animates in from top
4. showSMSPrompt() — hides #bottom-nav, shows overlay + sheet, animates sheet up, calls renderSMSPrompt()
5. renderSMSPrompt() step 1 — shows raw SMS, parsed grid, classify options
6. User selects Recurring/Trial → re-render → Next button appears
8b. Trial: user picks date from date input + sees warning box
9. completeSMSFlow() — validates → pushes new subscription to state.subscriptions → smsQueue.shift() → closeSMSPrompt() → after 500ms navigate('dashboard') + showToast success

add_card.success_action: push card to state.cards, reset state.newCard, navigate('dashboard'), toast 'Card added successfully'

icons_reference._note: All Material Symbols Outlined. Add FILL=1 via style for filled variant.

non_negotiable_rules: Background is ALWAYS #0e0e0e — never white, never light grey, anywhere in the app
ALL cards (bank cards) use rounded-full — never rounded-xl or rounded-2xl
Every interactive element has active:scale-95 transition-transform for tactile feedback
Bottom nav is frosted glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-opacity/80) with rounded-t-3xl top corners
Manrope (font-headline) on ALL headings, numbers, wordmarks, button text
Inter (font-body / font-label) on ALL body copy, descriptions, small labels
Each bank card has a unique gradient — HDFC=crimson, ICICI=orange, SBI=navy, Axis=burgundy
Stacked wallet uses absolute positioning + z-index layers for 3D depth illusion
Alerts screen must sort subscriptions by renewalDays ascending
Bottom nav hides when SMS bottom sheet is open
Toast and sheet animations use requestAnimationFrame pattern with cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)
Number formatting uses .toLocaleString('en-IN') for Indian comma style (₹3,626 not ₹3626)
on-primary (#3f4041) is a DARK color — it is text placed on top of the light primary (#c6c6c7)
Do not use CSS keyframe animations for show/hide — use the JS transform + rAF pattern
